full_judgment: 30. In the case of Anisminic Ltd. Vs. Foreign Compensation Commission, reported in 1969 (2) Appeal Cases 147 the House of Lords considered section 4 of the Foreign Compensation Act, 1950 "the determination by the Commission of any application made to them under this Act shall not be called in question in any Court of Law." Their Lordships by majority came to the conclusion that this section cannot prevent the Court from making any declaration that the commissioner's declaration was a nullity. This is the last word from the English jurisdiction.
